name: The Aurora Garden of Singing Glass Flowers

prompt: Aurora garden with crystalline glass flowers blooming, each flower emitting resonating chimes that cause colorful light ripples, aurora borealis dancing in sky, petals sparkling, magical realism, ultra-detailed, symphonic visual.
caption: Let glass flowers sing and aurora bloom 🎶🌿 Hear the music of shimmering petals.
